prompt: Edit the supplied Itsy Web logo specimen. The reference is the exact approved TYPOGRAPHY and presentation source, not merely style inspiration. Preserve the “Itsy Web” wordmark's letter shapes, rounded sans character, weight, spacing, capitalization, position, size and color EXACTLY in both the large lockup and the reversed small lockup. Do not redesign, substitute or redraw the lettering. Preserve the 1536 by 1024 landscape composition, pale ice background, navy strip and their geometry. Change ONLY the symbol to the left of the wordmark, the small standalone symbol at bottom left, and the symbol on the navy strip, consistently in all three positions. The product lets developers write HTML with layouts and partials, then serves and deploys the site without a frontend build pipeline. The replacement symbol must be compact, ownable and readable at favicon size, with the same bold, softly rounded graphic character as the lettering. Deep navy #142b43 and ice blue #a4dbff only, flat vector-friendly silhouette. No added text, labels, watermarks, gradients, shading or mockup objects. Create a new UPRIGHT IW LIGATURE mark, clearly different from the existing flowing squiggle. A compact lowercase i is joined to a broad, upright w through one sturdy stroke. Retain a small ice-blue dot as a separate accent; build the navy body with short verticals, rounded internal bowls and resolved endpoints. It should have a poised, compact near-square footprint and clearer letter recognition than the original broad swoosh. It must not look like a generic app-store initial, checkmark, tick, zigzag, infinity sign or the original mark merely rotated.
preserve: Approved wordmark typography and specimen layout
